questions.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?

questions.SQL: SELECT T2.cl0046 FROM tb001 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb003 AS T2 ON T1.cl0001 = T2.cl0001 WHERE T2.cl0065 = 31 ORDER BY T1.cl0019 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
questions.evidence: Excellence rate = cl0040 / cl0036; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = cl0025 / cl0024
questions.SQL: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.cl0025 AS REAL) / T1.cl0024) FROM tb001 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb002 AS T2 ON T1.cl0001 = T2.cl0030 WHERE CAST(T2.cl0040 AS REAL) / T2.cl0036 > 0.3
questions.SQL_original: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.cl0036) FROM tb002 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb003 AS T2 ON T1.cl0030 = T2.cl0001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.cl0060) = '1980' AND T2.cl0044 = 'Fresno'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

questions.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.

questions.SQL: SELECT cl0063, cl0039, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cl0039 DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM tb003 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb002 AS T2 ON T1.cl0001 = T2.cl0030 WHERE T2.cl0039 > 499 AND NOT cl0063 IS NULL

questions.question: What is the percentage of the cards with a converted mana cost of 7 in the set Coldsnap?
questions.evidence: converted mana cost of 7 refers to cl0099 = 7; card set Coldsnap refers to cl0137 = 'Coldsnap'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(cl0099 = 7), SUM(cl0099))*100

questions.question: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.
questions.evidence: pre-modern format refers to cl0164 = 'premodern' ;do not have multiple faces refers to cl0152 IS NULL
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.cl0089) FROM tb004 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb006 AS T2 ON T1.cl0160 = T2.cl0160 INNER JOIN tb009 AS T3 ON T1.cl0160 = T3.cl0160 WHERE T2.cl0164 = 'premodern' AND T3.cl0156 = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.cl0152 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T3.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.Side IS NULL

questions.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
questions.evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to cl0165 = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(cl0165 = 'Banned'))
questions.SQL: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT cl0164, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM tb006 WHERE cl0165 = 'Banned' GROUP BY cl0164 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.cl0164, T1.cl0137 FROM tb004 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb006 AS T2 ON T2.cl0160 = T1.cl0160 INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS MB ON MB.cl0164 = T2.cl0164 WHERE T2.cl0165 = 'Banned'
questions.SQL_original: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'

questions.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; Consumption decrease rate = (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(cl0193, 1, 4) = '2012', cl0198, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(cl0193, 1, 4) = '2013', cl0198, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(cl0193, 1, 4) = '2012', cl0198, 0)) FROM tb014 WHERE cl0184 = (SELECT T1.cl0184 FROM tb013 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb011 AS T2 ON T1.cl0187 = T2.cl0187 WHERE T1.cl0193 = '2012-08-25' AND T1.cl0197 = 1513.12)
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2013', Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = ( SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.Price  = 1513.12 )

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price  = 548.4

questions.question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T2.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch'

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

questions.question: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
questions.evidence: gold-eyed refers to cl0333 = 'Gold' where cl0340 = cl0333.cl0330; superheroes that Marvel Comics published refers to cl0335 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.cl0330) FROM tb050 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb048 AS T2 ON T1.cl0344 = T2.cl0330 INNER JOIN tb046 AS T3 ON T1.cl0340 = T3.cl0330 WHERE T2.cl0335 = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.cl0333 = 'Gold'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.colour = 'Gold'

questions.question: Describe the names of neutral alignment superheroes.

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'

questions.question: Which superheroes have blue eyes with brown hair?
questions.evidence: which superheroes refers to cl0337; blue eyes refers to color = 'Blue' and color.cl0330 = cl0340; brown hair refers to color = 'Brown' and color.cl0330 = cl0341;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.cl0337 FROM tb050 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb046 AS T2 ON T1.cl0340 = T2.cl0330 INNER JOIN tb046 AS T3 ON T1.cl0341 = T3.cl0330 WHERE T2.cl0333 = 'Blue' AND T3.cl0333 = 'Brown'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'

questions.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
questions.evidence: name refers to cl0337; the tallest hero refers to MAX(cl0346); published by Marvel Comics refers to cl0335 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT cl0337, cl0346, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cl0346 DESC) AS HeightRank FROM tb050 INNER JOIN tb048 ON tb050.cl0344 = tb048.cl0330 WHERE tb048.cl0335 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

questions.question: How many powers does Amazo hero have?
questions.evidence: Amazo hero refers to cl0337 = 'Amazo';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.cl0352) FROM tb053 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb050 AS T2 ON T1.cl0348 = T2.cl0330 WHERE T2.cl0337 = 'Amazo'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.power_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.hero_id = T2.id WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Amazo'

questions.question: What is the ratio of outpatient to inpatient followed up treatment among all the 'SLE' diagnosed patient?
questions.evidence: 'SLE' diagnosed patient means cl0360 = 'SLE'; inpatient refers to cl0370 = '+'; outpatient refers to cl0370 = '-'; calculation =  DIVIDE(COUNT(cl0353) where cl0360 = 'SLE' and cl0370 = '+', COUNT(cl0353) where cl0360 = 'SLE' and cl0370 = '-')
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cl0370 = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN cl0370 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tb055 WHERE cl0360 = 'SLE'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

questions.question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
questions.evidence: How old the patient refers to SUBTRACT(year(cl0354), year(cl0367)); the highest hemoglobin count refers to MAX(cl0388)
questions.SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.cl0371) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.cl0367), T1.cl0360 FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 ORDER BY T2.cl0388 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday), T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase, when was the youngest of them born?
questions.evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to cl0372 > = 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.cl0367 FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 WHERE T2.cl0372 >= 60 ORDER BY T1.cl0367 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
questions.evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to cl0390 <= 100 or cl0390 >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to cl0390 < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(cl0390 < 100), SUM(cl0390 > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to cl0390 > 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.cl0390 <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.cl0390 >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

questions.question: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
questions.evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cl0353); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.cl0353, T1.cl0366 FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 WHERE T2.cl0381 >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.cl0366, T1.cl0353
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.ID,T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX,T1.ID

questions.question: How many patients with an Ig G higher than normal?
questions.evidence: Ig G higher than normal refers to cl0398 >= 2000; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cl0353) FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 INNER JOIN tb054 AS T3 ON T3.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 WHERE T2.cl0398 >= 2000
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

questions.question: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
questions.evidence: laboratory examinations take in 1984 refers to YEAR(cl0371) = '1984'; below 50 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(cl0367)) < 50; normal platelet level refers to cl0390 between 100 and 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cl0353 FROM tb055 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb056 AS T2 ON T1.cl0353 = T2.cl0353 WHERE T2.cl0390 BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.cl0371) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.cl0367) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.cl0371) = '1984'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'

questions.question: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?
questions.evidence: have phosphorus as atom elements refers to cl0416 = 'p'; have nitrogen as atom elements refers to cl0416 = 'n'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.cl0417 FROM tb057 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb059 AS T2 ON T1.cl0414 = T2.cl0414 WHERE T2.cl0417 IN (SELECT T3.cl0417 FROM tb059 AS T3 INNER JOIN tb057 AS T4 ON T3.cl0414 = T4.cl0414 WHERE T4.cl0416 = 'p') AND T1.cl0416 = 'n'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN ( SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p' ) AND T1.element = 'n'

questions.question: What type of bond is there between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20?
questions.evidence: type of bond refers to cl0418; between the atoms TR004_8 and TR004_20 refers to cl0414 = 'TR004_8' AND cl0419 = 'TR004_20' OR another way around
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.cl0418 FROM tb058 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb059 AS T2 ON T1.cl0417 = T2.cl0417 WHERE T2.cl0414 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.cl0419 = 'TR004_20' OR T2.cl0419 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.cl0414 = 'TR004_20'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.bond_type FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20'

questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element LIMIT 3

questions.question: List all the elements of the toxicology of the molecule "TR004".

questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

questions.question: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
questions.evidence: cl0420 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to cl0418 = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(cl0418 = '#') * 100, COUNT(cl0417)) as percent where cl0420 = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.cl0420 = '+' THEN T2.cl0415 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.cl0415) FROM tb057 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb060 AS T2 ON T1.cl0415 = T2.cl0415 INNER JOIN tb058 AS T3 ON T2.cl0415 = T3.cl0415 WHERE T3.cl0418 = '#'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

questions.question: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?
questions.evidence: TR144_8_19 is the bond id;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.cl0416 FROM tb059 AS T1 INNER JOIN tb057 AS T2 ON T1.cl0414 = T2.cl0414 WHERE T1.cl0417 = 'TR144_8_19'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
